title_sq: Tek Forest Residence, Shitet Super Apartament 1+1, Me Orientim Dhe Planimetri Perfekte!!!
description_sq: Tek Forest Residence, Shitet Super Apartament 1+1, Me Orientim Dhe Planimetri Perfekte!!! Prona ndodhet ne katin e 8 (te fundit) si dhe ka nje siperfaqe bruto prej 79 m2, nga ku siperfaqja neto eshte 69.4 m2. Organizohet nga korridori shperndares, dhoma e ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit, dhoma e gjumit, tualeti dhe ballkoni. Orientimi i prones eshte jug-lindje, gje e cila mundeson ndricim gjate gjithe dites. Vetem 15 minuta nga qendra e Tiranes, pozicioni i kompleksit mundeson akses te drejtperdrejte ndaj sherbimeve si: shkolla, spitale, qendra tregtare, transport urban, etj. Per kete projekt eshte konceptuar nje zone perimetrale e gjelberuar dhe rekreative prej 8000m². Projektimi i qendrueshem eshte nje nder pikat e forta te zhvillimit te ketij kompleksi, duke perdorur teknologji bashkekohore dhe standarde europiane me aplikimin e fasades dhe vetratave termike. Aktualisht godina eshte ne faze suvatimi.
title_en: At Forest Residence, Super Apartment 1+1 For Sale, With Perfect Orientation And Layout!!!
description_en: At Forest Residence, Super Apartment 1+1 For Sale, With Perfect Orientation And Layout!!! The property is located on the 8th (top) floor and has a gross area of ​​79 m2, from which the net area is 69.4 m2. It is organized by the distribution corridor, the living room together with the kitchen corner, the bedroom, the toilet and the balcony. The orientation of the property is south-east, which enables lighting throughout the day. Only 15 minutes from the center of Tirana, the location of the complex allows direct access to services such as: schools, hospitals, shopping centers, urban transport, etc. A green and recreational perimeter area of ​​8000m² has been conceived for this project. The sustainable design is one of the strong points of the development of this complex, using contemporary technology and European standards with the application of the facade and thermal windows. Currently, the building is in the plastering stage.
